summary: Block walk start when dogWalkers.currentPrice is null or '0.00'. Enforcement at two layers: (1) server action in walksRepo.startWalk() — extend the existing assignment query to also fetch currentPrice and throw 'Price not set' before inserting the walk row; (2) UI in WalkerDashboardClient.tsx — replace the start button with a calm inline notice when the dog's currentPrice is '0.00' or empty. No new files needed. All touched files are within the allowlist.
validation_plan: TypeScript: npx tsc --noEmit — expect zero new errors
Lint: eslint on both touched files — expect zero new warnings
Manual (server guard): with a dog assigned at price 0.00, call startWalkAction — expect thrown error 'Price not set' and no walk row inserted in DB
Manual (UI guard): load walker dashboard with a 0.00-price dog — expect start button replaced by inline notice, no start possible without JS bypass
Manual (happy path): with a dog assigned at price > 0.00, start walk normally — expect redirect to /walker/live as before
risks: Existing seeded test data has currentPrice='0.00' (default in assignWalker) — all currently-assigned dogs without a price set will be blocked immediately on deploy. This is the intended product behaviour but may surprise testers who haven't set a price.
The UI guard is cosmetic only — a determined client could still POST to startWalkAction. The server-side check in walksRepo.startWalk() is the real gate and is enforced unconditionally.

getActionError() in WalkerDashboardClient maps unknown server errors to a generic string. The 'Price not set' error from the server will surface via that path if the client-side guard is somehow bypassed — the Hebrew message shown to the walker should be set explicitly in the UI layer, not rely on server error passthrough.
follow_up_recommendation: After this task ships: (1) confirm the owner set-price path is discoverable from the owner dashboard — Phase 1 incomplete-setup indicator already exists but the UX path from that indicator to set-price should be verified end-to-end; (2) add a focused Playwright smoke test for the price-block scenario.
